title: Mapping a buffer tape through an embedding
statement: Let $e$ be an injective map from the Boolean alphabet into an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $w$ be a Boolean word, and let $p$ be an integer cell. The buffer tape storing the word obtained by applying $e$ to each symbol of $w$, at cell $p$, equals the optional symbol on the buffer tape for $w$ at $p$ mapped through $e$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an embedding of the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$
